parameters.content:
**Trigger & Signature Validation**
Starts when a rep checks 'Trigger Re-engagement' on a HubSpot contact.

The raw webhook body is verified against HubSpot's Signature v3 header (HMAC using the app's client secret, env var HUBSPOT_CLIENT_SECRET) before anything else runs. Only then are valid trigger_re_engagement=true events extracted.

**Contact Retrieval, Rate-Limit Protection & Deleted-Contact Handling**
HubSpot fetch now requests all 6 properties needed downstream, retries 429/5xx up to 4x fixed 3s retry, and no longer crashes the execution if the contact was deleted during a database cleanup - it routes to the Skipped Log instead.

**Idempotency + Cooldown + Eligibility Gate**
Dedup key is now Contact Email + Campaign Segment (not email alone), with a 90-day cooldown. A separate eligibility gate then checks campaign_eligibility_reason == 'Eligible', rejects empty/'Not eligible' campaign_segment, and excludes Partners from reengagement campaigns. Anything rejected goes to the shared Skipped Log - no error email is generated for expected business skips.

**Context Reuse Branch**
If the contact already has ai_context_summary + ai_personalisation_hook, Gmail is only searched for messages after the shared cutoff date (Config node). No new messages -> Claude reuses the stored context untouched (near-zero Gmail/token cost). New messages -> only the new messages are trimmed and merged with the existing context. First-time contacts fall back to the original full-thread path.

**AI Analysis, Parse Gate & Context Write-Back**
maxTokens raised to 2000. The parser now sets parse_succeeded=false on malformed/incomplete JSON instead of silently forwarding an 'Error' string into HubSpot - a dedicated IF gate keeps any failed parse out of the CRM and routes it to the Skipped Log. On success, Claude's updated summary/hook are written back onto the HubSpot contact so future runs can reuse them.

**CRM Update & Human Review (no Encharge here)**
HubSpot Note body and every downstream HTTP body use a single JSON.stringify() expression, so nothing Claude writes can break the request payload. The draft goes straight to the Review Board for human approval - Encharge is NOT called from this flow anymore.

**Shared Skipped Log**
Every expected business skip (deleted contact, cooldown, ineligible, AI parse failure) lands here with a reason instead of triggering an error email. Create a 'Skipped Log' tab in the same spreadsheet with: Timestamp, Contact Email, HubSpot Contact ID, Segment, Campaign Segment, Skip Reason, Failed Step.

**FLOW B - Approval -> Encharge (separate trigger)**
Polls the Review Board sheet for edits. When Status becomes 'Approved', the contact is re-fetched live from HubSpot and re-checked against the same eligibility rules before Encharge is ever called - a lot can change between draft creation and human approval. If no longer eligible, the row is marked Blocked with a reason instead of sending.

**FLOW C - Error Monitoring With Alert Capping**
Unhandled system failures (HubSpot down, Sheets down, Anthropic down, credential errors, code exceptions) still raise an email - but identical errors are deduped to one email per 30-minute window per error signature, with every occurrence logged to the Alert Log tab regardless. Expected business conditions no longer reach this trigger at all since they're handled as normal IF branches in Flow A.
